title: Duskin suspends Mister Donut online ordering service after a breach, Security NEXT reports
date_note: Security NEXT, published 24 Nov 2026, gives 15 Nov as the day of the incident; the page gives no figures.
summary: Security NEXT reports that Duskin's Mister Donut online ordering service, Misdo Net Order, was breached on 15 November. The company shut the system down, blocked access, carried out emergency maintenance and is investigating. Orders already placed by members are being changed or cancelled at stores and through the customer center. The article gives no number of affected users.
plain: Mister Donut's online ordering service was breached and has been suspended while the company investigates, Security NEXT reports.
exec: A restaurant chain's online ordering service is suspended after a breach, and existing orders are being changed or cancelled.

sources.name: Security NEXT: ネットオーダーで侵害、サービスを停止 - ミスド

validation.note: One publisher (Security NEXT) relaying the company's notice; the company's own page was not readable in this run.

review.note: action advice: removed unsourced follow-notices advice; date 15 Nov, status and actions match Security NEXT
